Так они и стояли в этой позе, оба молча: Фрэнсис смущённый, Королева слабо вздыхающая, а женский гнев пола терзал сердце Леонсии, пока Генри не выпалил по-английски, ликуя:", "source_sha256": "1723abd2013f54e3feedfef2add4805046a59c5544f5b4a8b6eff8b9d18f96d7", "target_id": "ru-ru78-u020-r0063", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "07f3de57c7bd6d1b1b94eb54694a8a72d792049932d9a971ab0643340b646ca6"}]}, "source_rows": [{"id": "ru78-u020-r0064", "tag": "p", "text": "“Do it again, Francis! “Do it again, Francis! She likes it!”

The Sun Priest hissed silencing command at him. But the Queen, half withdrawing her hand with a startle like a maiden’s, returned it as deeply as before into Francis’ clasp, and addressed herself to Henry.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u020-r0066", "tag": "p", "text": "“I, too, know the language you speak,” she admonished. “Yet am I unashamed, I, who have never known a man, do admit that I like it. It is the first kiss that I have ever had. Francis——for such your friend calls you——obey your friend. I like it. I do like it. Once again kiss my hand.”", "sha256": "24a1c9c03834aec5f52667293c0efa7ad43958f01ee122f576aea2ab475887ae", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1707]", "source_html": "

“I, too, know the language you speak,” she admonished. “Yet am I unashamed, I, who have never known a man, do admit that I like it. It is the first kiss that I have ever had. Francis——for such your friend calls you——obey your friend. I like it. I do like it. Once again kiss my hand.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u020-r0067", "tag": "p", "text": "Francis obeyed, waited while her hand still lingered in his, and while she, oblivious to all else, as if toying with some beautiful thought, gazed lingeringly up into his eyes. By a visible effort she pulled herself together, released his hand abruptly, gestured him back to the others, and addressed the Sun Priest.", "sha256": "bbeec9d2c29512ff37f87802fcb4bbc450bd3093d485c8864d00f615a9d25a60", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1708]", "source_html": "

Francis obeyed, waited while her hand still lingered in his, and while she, oblivious to all else, as if toying with some beautiful thought, gazed lingeringly up into his eyes. By a visible effort she pulled herself together, released his hand abruptly, gestured him back to the others, and addressed the Sun Priest.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u020-r0068", "tag": "p", "text": "“Well, priest,” she said, with a return of the sharpness in her voice, “You have brought these captives here for a reason which I already know. Yet would I hear you state it yourself.”", "sha256": "160e18efc56a317a1d02307ad2804e1d77a759dca407a785327b3959e0cd89a5", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1709]", "source_html": "

“Well, priest,” she said, with a return of the sharpness in her voice, “You have brought these captives here for a reason which I already know. Yet would I hear you state it yourself.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u020-r0069", "tag": "p", "text": "“O Lady Who Dreams, shall we not kill these intruders as has ever been our custom? The people are mystified and in doubt of my judgment, and demand decision from you.”", "sha256": "6d24a8798ec14fe184aef5ccb3c264bc78f76df0c702c724c5515cdeae65bcc0", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1710]", "source_html": "

“O Lady Who Dreams, shall we not kill these intruders as has ever been our custom? The people are mystified and in doubt of my judgment, and demand decision from you.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u020-r0070", "tag": "p", "text": "“And you would kill?”", "sha256": "5ed78c41db6210034d270a4517b86d39a5f08445ae147c3fd89a97c58c066e29", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1711]", "source_html": "

“And you would kill?”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u020-r0071", "tag": "p", "text": "“Such is my judgment. I seek now your judgment that yours and mine may be one.”", "sha256": "b405f8ac07a820cc8a19b3e25e12686d01795051c33c295ffbef9dfbc7ff03b4", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1712]", "source_html": "

“Such is my judgment. I seek now your judgment that yours and mine may be one.”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u020-r0072", "tag": "p", "text": "She glanced over the faces of the four captives. For Torres, her brooding expression portrayed only pity. To Leoncia she extended a frown; to Henry, doubt. And upon Francis she gazed a full minute, her face growing tender, at least to Leoncia’s angry observation.", "sha256": "5e497bc84257d3a24a64f714a377421bc0890e3cd5bc32026ba348bf5163975e", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1713]", "source_html": "

She glanced over the faces of the four captives. For Torres, her brooding expression portrayed only pity. To Leoncia she extended a frown; to Henry, doubt. And upon Francis she gazed a full minute, her face growing tender, at least to Leoncia’s angry observation.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u020-r0073", "tag": "p", "text": "“Are any of you unmarried?” the Queen asked suddenly. “Nay,” she anticipated them. “It is given me to know that you are all unmarried.” She turned quickly to Leoncia. “Is it well,” she demanded, “that a woman should have two husbands?”", "sha256": "b864d586b2f8a3b552a4b098e91a99c674fd8d5eb54d523fea64fd3ec5d5aebe", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1714]", "source_html": "

“Are any of you unmarried?” the Queen asked suddenly. “Nay,” she anticipated them. “It is given me to know that you are all unmarried.” She turned quickly to Leoncia. “Is it well,” she demanded, “that a woman should have two husbands?”

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u020-r0074", "tag": "p", "text": "Both Henry and Francis could not refrain from smiling their amusement at so absurdly irrelevant a question. But to Leoncia it was neither absurd nor irrelevant, and in her cheeks arose the flush of anger again. This was a woman, she knew, with whom she had to deal, and who was dealing with her like a woman.", "sha256": "7e51c6110e213e6a69d425f9f6568f01625abdb4bbac54963163ebc17747ff07", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1715]", "source_html": "

Both Henry and Francis could not refrain from smiling their amusement at so absurdly irrelevant a question. But to Leoncia it was neither absurd nor irrelevant, and in her cheeks arose the flush of anger again. This was a woman, 186she knew, with whom she had to deal, and who was dealing with her like a woman.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u020-r0075", "tag": "p", "text": "“It is not well,” Leoncia answered, with clear, ringing voice.", "sha256": "cffebd70a6fc7ae5e429f41dcad4190cf01120f8dafc4d62fa27777a7c126657", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1716]", "source_html": "

“It is not well,” Leoncia answered, with clear, ringing voice.

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u020-r0076", "tag": "p", "text": "“It is very strange,” the Queen pondered aloud. “It is very strange. Yet is it not fair. Since there are equal numbers of men and women in the world, it cannot be fair for one woman to have two husbands, for, if so, it means that another woman shall have no husband.”", "sha256": "e7371b742ed3775a8c16549557172b860a2f5acd3ea4f6c32a1ec74b35778c72", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1717]", "source_html": "

", "emphasis_spans": 0}, {"id": "ru78-u020-r0078", "tag": "p", "text": "“The Mirror of the World will tell me, priest, what disposition shall be made of our captives.”", "sha256": "dec8dfefcc52f76e95ccb4d6acaaa45885c65714e547649860ca1e4575c2e4fe", "source_xpath": "/html/body/p[1719]", "source_html": "
